title: Attention over noisy examples: generalization and memorization in the exponential Hopfield network
abstract: arXiv:2610.22191v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In Hebbian learning from examples a Hopfield network of $N$ neurons is not supplied with the $K$ archetypes it has to retrieve but with $M$ blurred examples of each, of quality $r$, and whether it can infer them depends on the load $\alpha=K/N$ (interference among them) and on the dataset entropy $\rho=(1-r^2)/(Mr^2)$ (how little the examples say about them). We transfer this protocol to the exponential Hopfield model, whose zero-temperature update is a step of softmax attention with the unlabelled examples as keys. A signal-to-noise analysis gives in closed form the overlap between the output and an unseen archetype, $m^{(1)}={\rm erf}(1/\sqrt{2\rho_{\rm eff}})$: the majority-rule law of the pairwise model at small load, with $\rho$ replaced by an attention entropy $\rho_{\rm eff}$ built from the weight the softmax gives to the correct class and the number of examples it spreads it over. translated_title: 对噪声样本的注意力：指数Hopfield网络中的泛化与记忆
translated_abstract: 在基于样本的Hebbian学习中，一个具有N个神经元的Hopfield网络并非被直接提供其需要检索的K个原型，而是被提供每个原型的M个质量为r的模糊样本；网络能否推断出原型，取决于负载α=K/N（原型之间的干扰程度）和数据集熵ρ=(1-r²)/(Mr²)（样本对原型所透露信息的多寡）。我们将这一协议移植到指数Hopfield模型上，该模型的零温度更新等价于一步softmax注意力，其中未标记的样本作为键。通过信噪比分析，我们以闭式形式给出了输出与未见过的原型之间的重叠：m^(1)=erf(1/√(2ρ_eff))，即小负载下成对模型的多数规则定律，只是其中的ρ被一个注意力熵ρ_eff所取代——该熵由softmax赋予正确类别的权重以及它将权重分散到的样本数量构成。由此得出两个结果。首先，在一个窗口内……
tldr: 该论文将含噪样本的Hebbian学习协议移植到等价于softmax注意力机制的指数Hopfield网络，并通过信噪比分析闭式推导出对未见原型的检索重叠公式m=erf(1/√(2ρ_eff))，其中数据集熵被由softmax权重构成的注意力熵所取代，从而刻画了注意力机制从噪声样本中实现泛化与记忆的条件。
en_tdlr: The paper ports the noisy-examples Hebbian learning protocol to the exponential Hopfield network, whose update is a softmax attention step, and derives in closed form the retrieval overlap with unseen archetypes, m=erf(1/sqrt(2ρ_eff)), showing that the dataset entropy is replaced by an attention entropy built from the softmax weights.
